abilities.effect: The creature fractures the thin crust of earth and falls through. That creature can use the Grab an Edge reaction to avoid falling, as long as it is adjacent to an edge. Otherwise it takes falling damage (typically 25 bludgeoning damage for a 50-foot drop). Some of these rifts eventually lead to the Darklands.
abilities.name: Long Fall
abilities.trigger: A creature steps onto the cracked earth

hazard.description: This 20-foot-by-20-foot patch of ground is cobwebbed with cracks and fissures that crumble when a creature steps on it.
hazard.disable: DC 16 Survival (untrained) to collapse safely; DC 20 Crafting (trained) to shore it up enough to pass over without collapsing it
hazard.name: Cracked Earth

traits.name: Environmental
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is something dangerous that’s part of the natural world, such as quicksand or harmful mold.
